Turnip Curry
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, February 14, 2010 - 6:03am

Ingredients




5 tablespoons Oil
1 pch Fennel seeds
2 pounds Turnip, sliced into 1" strip
2 teaspoons Salt
teaspoon Turmeric
teaspoon Cumin, ground
1 cup Water
teaspoon Red chile, crushed
tablespoon Cilantro, chopped

Preparation

1 Heat oil in a large skillet with a tight-fitting lid. Add fennel seeds & turnip strips. Fry, stirring, for 2 to 4 minutes over medium heat. Add salt, turmeric & cumin & mix well. Cover & cook gently over low heat for 10 minutes, the turnip should be soft. Uncover & drain off any excess oil. Add water, stirring & cook over medium heat for 3 minutes. Remove from heat & sprinkle in the crushed chiles & cilantro. Serve with rice &  2 Pranati Sen Gupta, "The Art of Indian Cuisine"
